quest.frigid.readme.readme.title: READ ME
quest.frigid.readme.readme.desc1:
&3Firstly, we'd like to thank you for playing &bFrigid!&3 We greatly appreciate it. If you have any issues, get help in our Discord server!

&9&ndiscord.marbledhubb.com
quest.frigid.readme.readme.desc2:
&3To get started and get some starter items, read through the tutorial quests. They will help guide, teach, and show you Frigid's mechanics and features! It's highly recomended.

Use your Quest Book or Quest Tab in your inventory to go to the quests.
quest.frigid.readme.readme.desc3:
&3We hope you have fun! If not, let us know how we can improve in our Discord!

&9&ndiscord.marbledhubb.com
quest.frigid.readme.disclaimer.title: &4&lDisclaimers&r
quest.frigid.readme.disclaimer.desc1:
&4&lDisclaimers&r

&3- This modpack contains &4&lloud sounds&r&3, and scary themes.

- Temperatures are in &4&lCelsius.&r&3

- For immersion, some items have been &4&l'removed'.&r&3 This is because they don't fit the theme of &bFrigid.&r&3 But, they are still in the creative tabs and JEI search just their recipes and loot tables have been removed.
quest.frigid.readme.stayupdate.title: Stay Updated
quest.frigid.readme.rateus.title: Rate Us

quest.frigid.hunting.title: Hunting \& Fishery
quest.frigid.hunting.subtitle: Hunting for your food.
quest.frigid.hunting.hunting.title: Hunting
quest.frigid.hunting.hunting.desc2: &3Regular farm animals &4no longer spawn&3 in abundance so you must work for your food. &eGood Lucky!
quest.frigid.hunting.oldworkbench.title: Old Workbench
quest.frigid.hunting.oldworkbench.desc1: &3To craft more ammo, you must either find or craft an &bOld Workbench.
quest.frigid.hunting.fishing.title: Fishing
quest.frigid.hunting.fishing.desc1:
&3Fishing is a good way to have a source of food.

It's reliable and easily done. Fishing in &bFrigid&3 has been overhauled with a small minigame, the better you do it, the better the catch.
quest.frigid.hunting.huntingfishery.desc:
&3Hunting is a key aspect of &bFrigid.

&3 Regular farm animals &4no longer spawn&3 in abundance so you must work for your food.

- You must hunt &bDeer&3 and &bGoat&3, for food and fur;

- And fish for food.
quest.frigid.hunting.mediumbullets.title: Medium Bullets
quest.frigid.hunting.mediumbullets.desc1: &3Using the &bOld Workbench&3, you can craft your ammunition for your hunting rifle.
quest.frigid.hunting.winchester.title: Winchester M1894
quest.frigid.hunting.winchester.desc1: &3Using the &bOld Workbench&3, you can craft your main hunting rifle.
quest.frigid.hunting.ice.title: Ice
quest.frigid.hunting.ice.desc1: &3While looking for an area to ice fish, you may stumble upon some fish frozen in ice.
quest.frigid.hunting.deer.title: Deer
quest.frigid.hunting.deer.desc1:
&3Deer are the main source of food, being common in &2forest&3 biomes.

They also drop &bFur&3 which you can use to insulate your armor.
quest.frigid.hunting.goat.title: Goat
quest.frigid.hunting.goat.desc1:
&3Goats are the main source of &bGoat Fur&3, which can be used for all sorts of things from armor insulation, to crafting wool.

They also can be a source of food. But you will only find them in &aplains&3 biomes as they migrated down due to the mountains getting too cold.
quest.frigid.hunting.rabbit.title: Rabbit
quest.frigid.hunting.rabbit.desc1:
&3Rabbits are a source of &bRabbit Hide&3, which is a source for &bLeather.

&3They can also be a source of food and are found in &2forest&3 biomes.
quest.frigid.hunting.fish.title: Fish
quest.frigid.hunting.fish.desc1:
&3Fish are a easily obtainable food source.

Rather than trying to spend a long while hunting for food, fish can be easily caught.
quest.frigid.hunting.qckloadtube.title: Quick Loading Tube
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.title: Staying Warm
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.subtitle: Ways to keep yourself warm.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.warmfoods.title: Food
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.heatsource.desc:
&3Heat sources are sources that of course keep the player warm.

The typs of heat sources are primarily &bblocks&3, &bitems&3, and &bfluids&3.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.armorinsulation:
&3The best long-term option.

Insulating your armor not only lets you have whatever armor you want, but also depending on how much you insulate it, can keep you very much warm and slow down the affects of the cold.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.stayingwarm.des:
&3One of the most important things to survive, if not the &bmost important thing&3, is to keep warm.

There are 3 main ways to keep warm.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.firewood.title: Firewood
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.firewood.desc1: &3Used to build or fuel &bCampfires&3, fuel &bFurnaces&3, &bBoilers&3, and the &bHearth&3.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.campfires.title: Campfire
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.campfires.desc1:
&3Campfires, made from &b4x Firewood&3 placed down and defined with &bCoal&3 or &bCharcoal&3 VIA right-click, are the best heat sources for early-game to mid-game.

They can keep you and your friends warm for as long as you fuel it.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.torches.title: Torches
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.torches.desc1:
&3Torches are a early-game heat source.

Not providing much heat, but easy to craft.

They do have a &bfinite lit time&3.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.matches.title: Matches
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.matches.desc1:
&3Matches replace &bFlint and Steel&3.

Matches serve the same function, like lighting up your torches and campfires.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.furnaces.title: Furnaces
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.furnaces.desc1: &3While not giving a lot of heat, it's still a &beasily obtainable&3 heat source.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.hearth.title: Hearth
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.hearth.desc1:
&3The best heat source for closed in or encased areas such as the inside of bases, homes, buildings, or structures.

&bThe Hearth&3 grants the &bWarmth effect&3, and the level of the effect increases gradually.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.boiler.title: Boiler
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.boiler.desc1: &3The Boiler is used to heat up &bWaterskins&3, but can also give off some heat.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.waterskin.title: Waterskin
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.waterskin.desc1:
&3Waterskins are containers of water that can be heated or cooled to &b-50° C/50° C&3.

Once consumed, the temperature of the Waterskin will be applied to the players temperature. They can also sit in the hotbar for passive heating/cooling.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.lava.title: Lava
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.lava.desc1: &3While it gives off a lot of heat, there's a high chance of standing too close and overheating or standing too far and freezing.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.lava.desc2: &3But, having it in a bucket can give off passive heat when in &bthe hotbar&3, even more so if it's directly in &bthe hand&3.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.goatfur.title: Goat Fur
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.goatfur.desc1:
&3Dropped by Goats.

Can be used for &bInsulation&3.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.fur.title: Fur
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.fur.desc1:
&3Dropped by animals that have fur, like Deer.

Can be used for &bInsulation&3.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.lantern.title: Lantern
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.lantern.desc1:
&3Lanterns give off a small amount of heat, which may not be a good heat source.

But, when in the &bhotbar&3 it can give off passive heat, even more so if it's &bdirectly in the hand&3.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.thermometer.des:
&3The Thermometer is an item that displays the body's temperature, giving percise information on how cold the player is.

This useful tool can only be found in &bCabins as rare loot&3.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.iceresistance.d:
&3Ice Resistance potions protect entities from freezing damage when they are too cold.

These cannot be brewed, and it is unknown where they can be found.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.candles.title: Candles
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.candles.desc1: &3While not being a good source of heat, Candles do give off a small amount of heat which can &bincrease with every extra candle&3.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.unlittorche.des: &3Torches can be lit when put on &bCampfires&3.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.wool.title: Wool
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.wool.desc1: &3Wool can also be used as an armor insulator, but with no Sheep around, it's &bhard to obtain&3.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.sleeping.title: Sleeping
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.sleeping.desc1:
&3If it is too cold, you won't be able to sleep.

The minimun temperature you can sleep at is &b8° Celsius&3.
quest.frigid.stayingwarm.other.title: Other
quest.frigid.transportation.title: Transportation
quest.frigid.transportation.subtitle: Ways to transport in the cold.
quest.frigid.transportation.sleds.title: Sleds
quest.frigid.transportation.sleds.desc1:
&3Sledding makes traversing easier and faster.

&bSleds&3 can go uphill and downhill, safely.

They also get faster and faster the longer you go.
quest.frigid.transportation.wolves.title: Wolves
quest.frigid.transportation.wolves.desc1:
&3Attaching a &btamed Wolf&3 to your Sled will make it go even faster.

And you get to have your best friend come along on your journey.
quest.frigid.transportation.transportati:
&3Traversing in &bFrigid&3 can be difficult due to the amount of snow on the ground.

Luckily, &bFrigid&3 also has some ways of transportation.
quest.frigid.transportation.insulatedmin: &3While Minecart use may not be that huge, a &bMinecart with Insulation&3 will keep you warm on your journey on the rails.
